'''Brolok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who earned the nickname "Boulder" and served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He supplied other hunters with equipment during the war and was stationed on board the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]]. Brolok wore a [[Color/Legends|green]] and yellow set of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] including a helmet, and worked in the supplies section of the station.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brolok was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as an Imperial ultimate gear vendor within the Imperial fleet. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
